stages.detail: Snapshot OK — 10,000 transactions, ~17,660 unique addresses. Window: ~30 minutes of Bitcoin history.
Graph OK — 17,660 address nodes, 10,000 transaction nodes, 14 features per address. Edge types: INPUT_TO, OUTPUT_TO.
Weak labels built — 17,660 addresses. Label distribution: {'unknown': 17660}. high_risk (training positives): 0.

GCN fail-closed correctly (exit 1). Reason: 10k snapshot covers ~30 minutes of Bitcoin history — no known seed addresses (Hydra, Garantex, etc.) transacted in that window. Training positives: 0. The frozen spec prohibits falling back to UNKNOWN-majority training. Resolution: run the 50k snapshot after BigQuery quota resets.

Layer 1 deterministic rules ran on 17,660 addresses. Addresses with ≥1 reason: 17,660. Sample: [('76a3c8e09315…', ['Unusual transaction volume burst (off-hours)']), ('c3cefc1138f9…', ['Unusual transaction volume burst (off-hours)']), ('52fbda5c0a62…', ['Unusual transaction volume burst (off-hours)'])]. Note: hops_to_flagged and cluster rules require seed coverage (available after 50k snapshot).

P2P simulation OK — 20 signals, all SIMULATED. IP clusters: ['IP_CLUSTER_01', 'IP_CLUSTER_02', 'IP_CLUSTER_03', 'IP_CLUSTER_04', 'IP_CLUSTER_06', 'IP_CLUSTER_07', 'IP_CLUSTER_08', 'IP_CLUSTER_11', 'IP_CLUSTER_12']. No real IP strings (P0.7.3 PASS). Disclaimer present on all records: '⚠ SIMULATED DATA — NOT REAL NETWORK TELEMETRY. Simulated/replayed demonstration data only.'

API OK — 5 routes registered: ['/api/v1/alerts', '/api/v1/graph', '/api/v1/health', '/api/v1/model/info', '/api/v1/wallets/{address_hash}']. OpenAPI spec: backend/openapi.yaml. Mock server: npx @stoplight/prism-cli mock backend/openapi.yaml
